results.title: RBI streamlines supervisory framework with 64 Master Directions, withdraws 628 circulars
results.description: The new directions consolidate 628 existing circulars, including Master Circulars and earlier Master Directions, into a streamlined framework covering 11 categories of regulated entities.

results.title: Rajkot Angadia Office Looted Of ₹19 Lakh In 20-Second Gunpoint Heist
results.description: In a daring daylight robbery that has sent shockwaves through Rajkot’s trading community, two armed men allegedly looted ₹19 lakh in cash from an angadia firm’s branch office and escaped within 20 seconds. The incident took place on Thursday morning in one of the city’s busiest jewellery trading hubs near Bhavnagar Road. results.title: Court hall crunch at Punjab and Haryana High Court: 69 halls for 85 sanctioned strength of judges
results.description: The figures showed that while the HC faces a shortage of court halls, the district judiciary has 31 court halls against a sanctioned strength of 30 judicial officers.
